zhvi_units: USD nominal (zhvi); USD of BASE_YEAR (zhvi_real), not index points
zhvi_annual_rule: calendar-year mean of monthly values, kept only when the year has 10+ months (fetch_data.annual_mean)
zhvi_geography: Zillow ZIP mapped to 2020 ZCTA by identity (docs/schema.md 4.1)
deflator: CPI-U CPIAUCSL annual mean from data/national_annual.csv; real = nominal * CPI[2025] / CPI[year]
acs_rule: year = last year of the 5-year window; adjacent windows share 4 years and are not annual observations
acs_dollars: median_hh_income in dollars of the window end year; real column deflated with CPI of that year

spillover.use: candidate demand-spillover source; never a control or donor
